data.gender_notes: Petreus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'petra' meaning 'rock'. In the New Testament, Saint Peter was given this name as a metaphor for his firm foundation in faith. The name Petreus carries the meaning “Rocky” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Petreus usually hope their child will grow to embody rocky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, stability, and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Petreus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rocky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petreus total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: פטרוס
in_hebrew.meaning: פטרוס נגזר מפטרה ומשמעותו אבן או סלע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פטרוס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו אבן או סלע. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'פטרה' (Πέτρα) שפירושה סלע או אבן. השם פטרוס הוא תרגום של השם הארמי 'כיפא' (כיפא), שגם הוא מתייחס לאבן או לסלע. השם פטרוס מוזכר בברית החדשה ככינויו של אחד מתלמידיו של ישו, שידוע גם כפיטר.

in_greek.name: Πέτρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Πέτρος (Petros) είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'πέτρα' (petra), που σημαίνει πέτρα ή βράχος. Το όνομα Petros ήταν ένα κοινό όνομα στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και ήταν επίσης το όνομα ενός από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, γνωστού ως Πέτρος ή Κηφάς.

in_latin.name: Petreus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Petreus derivatur a Graeco 'Πέτρος' (Petros), quod significat petra seu rupes. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Petreus fuit cognomen unius de duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi, qui etiam Petrus vel Cephas dicebatur. Nomen hoc habet magnam significationem spiritualem, quia Christus dixit Petro 'Tu es Petrus, et super hanc petram aedificabo Ecclesiam meam'.

in_english.name: Petreus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Petreus originates from the Greek 'Πέτρος' (Petros), meaning rock or stone. In the New Testament, Petreus is another name for Saint Peter, one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles. The name holds significant spiritual meaning, as Jesus said to Peter, 'You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church.' The name Petreus symbolizes strength, stability, and leadership.

celebrity_usage: A fictional character in the Star Wars universe.
data.cultural_impact: The name Petra came to Europe through Greece and Rome, and has been widely used in the Western World ever since. It was popularized by the Roman Catholic Church, which celebrated Saint Peter as one of its founding figures.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Saint Peter is considered the first pope and the leader of the apostles. He is known for his steadfast faith, which has made 'Petra' a powerful name signifying strength, stability, and a foundation in faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Petreus is derived from the Latin word "petra," meaning rock. In Christian symbolism, this name represents steadfastness and strength, reminding us of the foundation of our faith on the unchangeable Word of God.

biblical_reference.note: The name Petreus is mentioned in the New Testament as an alternative name for Saint Peter.

historical_references.reference: Petreus was a Roman general who served under the Emperor Nero during the Roman-Jewish War of AD 66-73. He was particularly successful in defeating Jewish forces under the command of Josephus in Galilee.

Petreus was also a Frankish nobleman in the late 5th century AD who served under Clovis I, the first king of the Franks. He played a key role in helping Clovis defeat the Alamanni in the Battle of Zülpich in AD 496.
